name: branch-assistant
description: AI-powered Git branch name generator for Antigravity (Gemini) & VS Code (GitHub Copilot)

commands.title: Branch Assistant: Create Branch with AI...
Branch Assistant: Commit to New Branch...
Branch Assistant: Generate Branch Name for Active Changes

enumDescriptions: Automatically detect: Use Gemini in Antigravity and GitHub Copilot in VS Code
branchAssistant.provider.description: The AI provider used to generate branch names.

enumDescriptions: Auto-select: sparkle icon in Antigravity, copilot icon in VS Code
Always show the GitHub Copilot icon $(copilot)
branchAssistant.icon.description: Controls the icon displayed in the branch naming input box.

branchAssistant.geminiApiKey.description: Optional Gemini API Key (if not using Antigravity internal auth or GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable).

branchAssistant.geminiModel.description: Gemini model to use for branch name generation.

branchAssistant.copilotModelFamily.description: Preferred GitHub Copilot model family (e.g. gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini).

branchAssistant.branchPrefix.description: Custom branch prefix (e.g. 'feature/', 'user/sven/'). Leave empty to inherit from git.branchPrefix.

enumDescriptions: Conventional prefixes (feat/, fix/, chore/, refactor/, docs/, test/)
Short hyphenated name without prefix (e.g. jwt-auth-validation)

branchAssistant.interceptNativeGitPrompt.description: Automatically attach the generate button to VS Code's native Git branch naming input box (e.g. when committing to a protected branch or using status bar).

branchAssistant.populateCommitMessage.description: Keep the AI-generated commit message in the Source Control input box when generating a branch name. Set to false if you prefer the commit message box to remain clean.
